audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ziggs five of seven rows including Level 6 and 2+ items, and rated the lane 8.5/10 difficulty, against a dead-even 50.53% win rate and prose that says 'At 6 the lane swings your way'.
audit.corrected: Chart realigned in both layers; difficulty 8.5/10 lowered to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text with no timings.
audit.why: Ziggs' windows are Bouncing Bomb at 4-6s and Satchel Charge at 12-20s; Gwen's are Level 6 and Riftmaker against an immobile mage.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge is described only as a knockback, Short Fuse is never mentioned, and Hexplosive Minefield's damage falloff is missing.
audit.why: Riot on Satchel Charge: 'The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage' — it is his peel AND his only escape, one button doing both jobs, which is why a spent Satchel is a commit window rather than just a dodged knockback. Riot on Hexplosive Minefield: 'Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage' — walking the field is far cheaper than it looks. Riot on Short Fuse: the empowered auto's 'cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability', so his spam feeds his auto damage.
audit.corrected: All three written into the phase whys, cooldown block, dos/donts and the interactions row.

audit.why: Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12s, Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s.
audit.corrected: All written into the cooldown block and trading rules.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Ziggs contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb is 850 range on a 6-second cooldown while you hold a short cone. Eat the poke, last-hit, and never chase him.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Ziggs's Satchel Charge is down.
edits.after: Short Fuse's empowered auto refreshes faster every time he casts, so his spam is also his damage.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ziggs must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash arrives. Hexplosive Minefield deals reduced damage on repeat detonations against the same target.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Satchel Charge's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Satchel Charge knocks you away on a 12-20s timer and doubles as his escape. Step up only once it has been spent.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ziggs's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: At 6 you commit. He has no dash — Satchel is one knockback, and inside Hallowed Mist he cannot target you from outside it.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Satchel Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — an immobile mage caught inside your own mist simply dies to it.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ziggs carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Positional late: you delete him the moment you touch him, but uncontested artillery pokes you off every single plate.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge (12-20s): it knocks you away and knocks him to safety, so it is peel and escape in one. Engage once it is spent. - Hexplosive Minefield (flat 16s): repeat detonations on you deal reduced damage. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Ziggs with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Ziggs with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Satchel Charge is spent — no dash and no second knockback for 12-20s, so commit. Bad trade: trading at 850 into Bouncing Bomb, where his 4-6s cooldown out-paces anything your cone reaches.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It knocks you away and knocks him to safety — one button, both jobs. Engage once spent.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: No dash: Satchel is his only escape, and it is 12-20 seconds.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Standing in the open at 850 range is free Bouncing Bomb damage every 4-6s.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Mist does not stop a bomb already in the air. Duck behind it early.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield's repeat detonations on the same target deal reduced damage — just walk it out.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-snip in the mist.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is both peel and escape, on 12-20s; Hexplosive Minefield's repeat hits on you deal reduced damage.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then shred him with %HP snips from inside the mist.
edits.after: Survive the bombs, then kill an immobile mage from inside your own mist.

notes: Rated 8.5/10 difficulty on a 50.0-ish win rate with Ziggs holding five of seven chart rows, including the Level 6 row the prose calls Gwen's swing. The useful mechanics — Satchel Charge being peel and escape in the same button (so a spent Satchel is a full commit window), Hexplosive Minefield's falloff on repeat detonations, and Short Fuse refreshing off every cast — were all absent.
